name: Liquidity void

definitions.definition_text: A liquidity void is a range in price delivery where one side of the market liquidity is shown in wide or long one-sided ranges or candles; price typically wants to revisit this porous range / void of contrarian liquidity. Contrasts with price in balance (small consolidation / equilibrium) before the voiding run.
definitions.variations_note: Overlaps FVG conceptually (Fgac lecture) but KEEP SEPARATE — void is the wide one-sided delivery object; FVG is the gap/imbalance framing.
